title: P1a: the compact packet reaches Codex — daemon.dispatch renders execute and fix-round prompts with packet=spawn.packet(task) instead of leaving the literal {{packet}} placeholder; the packet gains a dependencies section (depends_on ids, titles, merged shas); Codex run rows carry packet_meta (chars, estimated tokens, hash) like Claude rows so input size per role is measurable
spec:
Phase I P1 (brief .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md, section P1 executor packet; measurement rule: record input sizes by role before and after). Base goal/T-0445 (P0 merged: attribution fields, stamps, scorecard.efficiency, baseline). VERIFIED defect: daemon.dispatch (daemon.py:536 on the Phase H head) calls spawn.render("execute", spec=, acceptance=, scope=) without packet=, while .orchestrator/prompts/execute.md line 1 is {{packet}} and render() only substitutes keys it is given, so Codex receives the literal string {{packet}} and none of the compact deterministic packet (objective, acceptance, base commit, scope symbols and tests, matching gotchas, verification command, evidence, H8 header) that spawn.packet builds (spawn.py:161-345). Only the Claude fallback (spawn.py:531-538), the headless decision packet and executor.reply's incompatible-resume repair call packet(). Codex execute input median over the last three days is about 315k tokens.
1. daemon.dispatch renders the execute prompt with packet=spawn.packet(task) (and the fix-round prompt path in daemon._fix_round_spec / auto_fix_round the same way where it renders for Codex); render() must fail loudly in tests if a {{...}} placeholder survives in the final prompt (add a check that raises or logs a bus event "unfilled_placeholder" with the key; tests assert no placeholder remains). Keep the Claude fallback path unchanged.
2. spawn.packet: add a "dependencies" section after evidence: for each id in task.depends_on, the id, title (first 90 chars), status, merged_into and merged sha when available (from the bus); empty section omitted. Never drop an acceptance criterion (H8 rule stays); the section counts toward the cap and is trimmed before acceptance and verify.
3. packet_meta on Codex rows: executor.start (and reply) receives the packet meta (chars, est_tokens = chars // 4, hash from the H8 header, version) and executor._run logs it in the run row as packet_meta with the same shape spawn.run_claude uses (spawn.py:409-439), so scorecard can compare input sizes per role before and after. Record prompt_chars on every execute row (Codex and Claude) as the length of the rendered prompt.
Tests: tests/test_daemon.py::test_dispatch_prompt_contains_packet_not_placeholder (dispatch a queued execute task with mocked executor.start; the prompt passed contains the packet header and objective and no "{{"), test_fix_round_prompt_contains_packet; tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_dependencies_section_lists_depends_on, test_render_flags_unfilled_placeholder; tests/test_executor.py::test_codex_run_row_has_packet_meta_and_prompt_chars. Existing tests green (test_execute_prompt_contains_packet and the H8 packet tests stay); .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; commit with the task id including every named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: no rendered execute or fix-round prompt contains a {{placeholder}}; Codex execute rows carry packet_meta and prompt_chars
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
